title: Dan Ferris: Copper Could Double—and He Says You Have to Own It | SIH
creator: MarketBeat
summary: A MarketBeat-hosted Stansberry Investor Hour episode where guest Dan Ferris (Stansberry Research) makes the case that copper could double and investors 'have to own it' over roughly five years. The interview is a tour of physical-scarcity investing: FCX — BUY (reiteration of Oct 3 BUY) — Freeport-McMoRan as the large, profitable, dividend-paying copper producer; SCCO — BUY — Southern Copper, the biggest proven copper reserves in the world, called a 'good conservative bet'; TDW — BUY — Tidewater, the world's largest offshore vessel fleet (200+), trading at ~40% of replacement cost, framed as 'where the refiners were 10 months ago'; RIO — BUY (soft) — controls Arizona's Resolution copper, a plausible government-backed target. On energy refiners he holds: VLO — HOLD (up ~120% since his December recommendation, 'I'm not selling,' buying here 'not a terrible idea' with lower expectations) and MPC — HOLD. Macro positioning: GLD — BUY ('have to' own gold as real money near $4,000) and UUP — BUY (dollar-index fund; the USD as the 'cleanest dirty shirt'). He explicitly declines rare-earth stocks (no call, noted UNCERTAIN). His closing framework: two forces drive global markets — financialization and physical scarcity — and investors should learn to exploit both.

calls.video_title: Dan Ferris: Copper Could Double—and He Says You Have to Own It | SIH
calls.thesis: Large profitable dividend-paying copper producer; "you have to own copper" over the next ~5 years (copper near $7/lb; price has to rise to fund $250B of needed supply investment). Reiteration of Oct 3 BUY.
calls.bull: Copper could double by early 2027; Freeport has massive reserve leverage.
calls.bear: Could retest $4-5/lb first; requires tolerance for drawdowns.

calls.thesis: Largest proven copper reserves in the world — "a good conservative bet" for longer-horizon commodity exposure in a retirement-style portfolio.
calls.bull: Reserve leverage means copper price gains flow straight through without new capex.
calls.bear: Small-cap explorers offer more upside but he advises against them for most investors.

calls.video_title: Dan Ferris: Copper Could Double—and He Says You Have to Own It | SIH
calls.thesis: "A great bet": Tidewater is the world's largest offshore-service-vessel fleet (200+ vessels), trading ~40% of replacement cost with day rates expected up $3-4k — "about where the refiners were 10 months ago".
calls.bull: Day-rate expansion drops straight to the bottom line; could "really rip" if oil stays elevated.
calls.bear: Depends on sustained offshore drilling demand and high oil prices.

calls.bull: Government push to onshore critical minerals could accelerate Resolution financing.
